transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess what brings me in is this memorial I’m putting together for my brother. It started out as something small, but it’s gotten a lot bigger than I meant it to. Most days I’m chasing down songs, calling people, planning displays and trips connected to it. My wife says I’ve pretty much pushed aside the garden, my walking group, and just about everything else.
Have you felt unusually energized, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts are racing lately?

Yes, my thoughts have been racing. My mind keeps jumping around—one minute I’m thinking about a display case for the memorial, then suddenly I’m planning a road trip to track down a cousin, then I’ve got a verse from some old ballad running through my head. I try to write it down in order, but I can’t slow it down enough.
Have you noticed that you need less sleep lately, like feeling rested after only a few hours of sleep?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been keeping close track of the hours. Some nights I’m up later than I mean to be, but I don’t know that I’d say I feel rested after just a few hours.
Would you say you feel like you need less sleep than usual, even if you haven’t been keeping track of the exact hours?

I don’t know if I’d put it that way. I stay up later sometimes because my head’s busy, but I haven’t really noticed needing less sleep or feeling fine on less. I just haven’t paid close enough attention to say.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high, overly happy, or irritable — like you were on top of the world or more powerful than usual?

Yes… there are times I feel really lit up, like I’ve got a purpose and everybody’s finally going to see what I’ve been trying to show about our family. It can feel like the whole town is going to understand it.

But then if my wife, or somebody at the senior center, slows me down or questions the display, I get irritated fast. I snap at them more than I probably should.
Can you think of a specific time recently when you felt you needed significantly less sleep than usual and still felt energetic?
I can’t think of a clear time like that, no. I’ve had nights where I was up late, but I wouldn’t say I felt like I needed way less sleep and was still energetic. I just don’t have a specific example.

Have there been a period of at least several days in a row where your mood was clearly different from usual—like feeling especially high, irritable, or energized—for most of the day, nearly every day?

Yes, I think so. There are stretches where I’m just… not myself. I feel lit up, like I’ve got this purpose, like everybody in town is finally going to understand what I’m showing about our family.

And during that time I get irritable too. If my wife or someone at the senior center slows me down or questions the display, I can snap pretty quick. It’s not just for a minute—it can go on like that for days.
How long did one of those stretches usually last—like the time you felt especially energized or irritable for several days in a row?
It’s been going on about two months now, I’d say. Since my brother passed and I started working on that tribute for him, that’s when these stretches really began.
Was there ever a time when you felt this way—really energized or irritable—for a whole week or more without letting up?
Yes. It’s been more than a week—really it’s been about two months now, since my brother passed and I started working on his tribute. It hasn’t really let up much.
Was there a time when your mood was so high or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self, and this lasted for a full week or more without stopping?

Yes. It’s been clearly different from how I usually am. I get this feeling like I’m lit up, full of purpose, like the whole town is going to finally understand our family. And then if my wife or somebody at the senior center slows me down or questions the display, I get irritable and snap at them. It’s not like me.
